description: This file is an implementation of the ProductOptionDao interface, providing database access methods for ProductOption entities, including listing, retrieving by ID or code, and saving or updating product options, with specific store and language filtering.

classes.name: ProductOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductOptionDao responsible for database operations related to ProductOption entities, utilizing QueryDSL for dynamic query construction and supporting store and language based filtering.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOption entities for a specific store and language, with associated descriptions fetched.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOption entity by its ID, including descriptions and store associations.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves ProductOption entities matching a name pattern within a specific store and language.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves ProductOption entities marked as read-only for a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new ProductOption or updates an existing one, handling entity state accordingly.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOption by its code within a specified store.
